description: [provider] Count companies matching a filter (free). Returns the total count of companies matching the given search criteria without retrieving the actual results (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE and it takes the entire search filter object, so it is the correct first call of any audience-building loop: tune filters here at zero cost, then spend credits once on the real search. Returns {count, total} where `count` is capped at the plan's page limit and `total` is the true match count.

technologies.description: same filter object as companyenrich.companies.search — every field there is accepted here

name: companyenrich_companies_search_count
